# QAZNEDR.KZ - Kazakhstan Mining Marketplace

QAZNEDR.KZ is a B2B marketplace for buying and selling mineral deposits, mining licenses, and geological services in Kazakhstan.

## What we offer:
- Mining licenses (active extraction rights)
- Exploration licenses (geological exploration permits)
- Mineral occurrences (documented mineral findings)
- Geology services (drilling, consulting, audit, legal, lab analysis)

## Regions covered: All 14 regions of Kazakhstan
## Languages: Russian, Kazakh, English, Chinese
## Target audience: Mining companies, investors (including Chinese), geologists, service providers

## Key URLs:
- Listings: /ru/listings
- Services: /ru/services/catalog
- API: /api/listings (public, JSON)
